notes.title: Flat Friday - Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38978508/7754da0ef5a13bbe881d000ce7628455777bad74.gif[/img]


Hello everyone, 

After going through all the feedback we got from different sources We have put together a Feature Update for you!

Orbit of the Moon can now be changed.
Orbit of the Sun can now be changed.
Secret Clues are revealed faster now.
Clouds now Move.
Updated Sun Model.
The Sun and The Moon now react to crashing into the surface of the Flat Earth.
Added the ability to toggle Clouds on and off.
Added a replay Intro button to the Main menu.
Added ability to display Air Traffic on the Flat Earth.
Secret Clues have been Updated.
Added 3 secret location Achievements to Unlock.
There are now 42 achievements to Unlock in total.
You can zoom in closer to the surface.


Thank you for Playing Flat Earth Simulator

The Truthtellers
